edges.notes: LLVM documents DWARF generation from its pipeline (SourceLevelDebugging.html).
GCC/Clang emit DWARF for typical C/C++ debug builds (-g); see GCC debugging options.
DWARF sections (.debug_*) are carried inside ELF objects in typical Unix toolchains.
objdump and readelf are standard inspectors for DWARF inside ELF objects.
Clang emits DWARF debug info for typical -g builds on ELF targets.
GCC emits DWARF for typical -g builds on ELF targets (GCC debugging options).
GDB consumes DWARF for source-level debugging.
LLDB consumes DWARF for source-level debugging on typical ELF targets.
C++ debug builds using libstdc++ emit DWARF describing STL types and inline code paths.
C++ debug builds using libc++ emit DWARF for libc++ types and inline paths alongside Clang.
Exception unwinding and debuggable stack walks interact with DWARF unwind info on ELF targets using libc++abi.
